canonical_name: No Physical and Environmental Threat Protection
description: Protection against physical and environmental threats is not designed and implemented.
applicability: Organizations requiring protection of information processing facilities from natural disasters, environmental hazards, and deliberate attacks

metadata.detection_notes: Review protection measures against natural disasters (fire, flood, earthquake), environmental threats (temperature, humidity), and malicious attacks. Absence of fire suppression, climate control, flood protection, or structural hardening indicates this deficiency.
